technique_name: Explain the difference between a neural network and an artificial neural network.
description: A neural network is a computing system that is inspired by biological neural networks, which use neurons and synapses to process information. An artificial neural network is a type of neural network that uses artificial intelligence (AI) to learn from examples and experiences, and is able to generalize what it has learned to unseen data.
